home.intro: Hey, I'm Niloy. I love to make software lighter and faster. At Adventure Dhaka Limited, I lead the frontend team behind a travel booking platform used by millions. [Off the clock](/off-the-clock), I build [small, fast tools](/work) and write about people — usually over tea.

stackStory: I think in {typescript} and speak fluent {javascript}. Interfaces take shape in {react}, {next-js} and {astro}, dressed in {tailwind-css}.
Client state stays light with {zustand}; server data stays fresh with {react-query}.
Data rests in {postgresql}, shaped by {drizzle} and kept close by {redis}, while files and images settle into {aws-s3}.
It all runs on {node-js} with {nestjs} for APIs, builds with {vite}, and ships to the edge on {vercel} and {cloudflare} — and nothing ships until {lighthouse} agrees it's fast.
After hours, I'm picking up {go} because simple should also be fast, losing friendly arguments with {rust}'s borrow checker, and smuggling near-native speed into the browser with {webassembly}.
home.contact: Have something that should be faster? Write to {email}, or find me on {github} and {linkedin}.
